deploy-bot: Kicking off staged rollout for release/v2.17.0 (version v2.17.0). Waves: US -> EU -> APAC. Change window 02:00-06:00 UTC. Start US at 5%, hold points at 5/25/100. Rollback triggers: 5xx > 0.5% for 10m OR p95 > 800ms for 5m OR >=3 OOMs on hosts. Auto-fallback allowed for region-specific model variants. Ops please ack.
rosa: Ack. I'll run capacity smoke + KV cache warmup. Warm pool target: 20 GPUs in us-east-1.
ken: Running capacity checks now. Current spare headroom: US ~18%, EU ~12%, APAC ~8%. Posting smoke outputs in 2.
sofia: Heads-up: APAC is close to committed quota for some Dedicated customers — if we hit 85% reserved, we'll want to soft-pin to a quantized variant in APAC.
vikram: Note on runtime: v2.17.0 uses new fused-attn kernel on aarch64. Found two older-driver nodes in apac that may miscompile. I'll exclude apac-stable node-pool from canary.
ken: Smoke results: US p95=120ms, 5xx=0.02% ; EU p95=140ms, 5xx=0.05% ; APAC initial p95=610ms, 5xx=0.3% (spikes from two hosts).
rosa: Starting US wave at 5% now.
rosa: `deploy --wave us --pct 5 --version v2.17.0 --pin release/v2.17.0`
deploy-bot: Wave US started @1729012345. Monitoring hooks: rollout-trace, model-quality, infra-metrics. Alert channel: #eng-oncall. Wave hold timeout: 15m.
james: I'll monitor eval set and alert if accuracy drops >2% vs baseline prompt set.

sofia: EU scheduled next at ~1729013400. APAC we'll run capacity reclaim before starting.
rosa: Bumping US to 25% now.
rosa: `deploy --wave us --pct 25`

rosa: `deploy --wave eu --pct 5`
deploy-bot: EU wave started @1729014000. Monitoring active.
ken: EU p95=160ms, 5xx=0.01% — clear. Kicking APAC reclaim now.

rosa: APAC scheduled start 1729017600. Ops confirm warm pool size 12 GPUs?

Closing thread; follow-up: infra to repro driver mismatch on apac hosts and schedule node-pool upgrade. Add to release notes: APAC fallback used; monitoring alerts and ops timeline included. :thumbsup:
